says: The label a part of a split retro report ends in: which part of how many, of which retro's report.
message: _Part {index} of {total} of the report of retro #{number}._

index.description: The part's number, from 1, digits alone.

total.description: How many parts the report is posted in, digits alone.

number.description: The retro issue's number, digits alone.
